mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_spu p WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId}) AS productCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_spu p WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND p.status = 1) AS onSaleProductCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_spu p WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND p.status = 0) AS offSaleProductCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId}) AS skuCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) <= COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10)) AS warningStockCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller_order_t so WHERE so.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND so.status = 1) AS pendingShipmentOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller_order_t so WHERE so.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND DATE(so.create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrderCount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(so.seller_amount) FROM seller_order_t so INNER JOIN order_t o ON o.id = so.order_id INNER JOIN payment_info pay ON pay.order_no = o.order_no AND pay.pay_status = 1 WHERE so.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND DATE(pay.pay_time) = CURDATE()), 0.00) AS todaySalesAmount

SELECT so.id AS id, o.order_no AS orderNo, so.seller_amount AS sellerAmount, so.status AS status, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, pay.pay_time AS paymentTime, so.create_time AS createTime FROM seller_order_t so INNER JOIN order_t o ON o.id = so.order_id LEFT JOIN payment_info pay ON pay.order_no = o.order_no AND pay.pay_status = 1 WHERE so.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY so.create_time DESC, so.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.name AS skuName, p.name AS productName, COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) AS availableStock, COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10) AS safetyStock FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.sku_id = s.id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND COALESCE(i.available_stock, s.stock) <= COALESCE(i.safety_stock, 10) ORDER BY availableStock ASC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
